notes: The byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a prank name; the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle The Dark as plain text (no player page), as with decks 19620, 19688, 19842, 20080 and 20227.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (7)': No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Tatooine: Mos Espa, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans and Do They Have A Code Clearance?; these count toward the 60.
'Admiral's Orders (2)' is a section header, not a card, and was removed. The Characters header says 20 but 19 are listed; the deck totals 58 as published.

Posted Kessel, Coruscant, Tatooine, Hoth, Bespin and Sullust dested the Dark system pages (Coruscant = Special Edition, Tatooine = Premiere, as nothing marks the Episode I printings); 'Coruscant Docking Bay' dested the Special Edition Coruscant: Docking Bay; 'Hoth Docking Bay' dested the Dark Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (Dark).

Posted 'PS-59' / 'PS-60' dested P-59 / P-60; 'Captain Pelleaon' dested Captain Gilad Pellaeon; 'Commander Merrejek' dested Commander Merrejk; 'We're in Attack Positon' dested We're In Attack Position Now; 'Empire's Back' dested The Empire's Back; 'Vengance', 'Chimaraea', 'Devasator' dested Vengeance, Chimaera, Devastator.
The strategy's 'response to reviews' lists swaps (Mandalorian Armor for Vader's Cape, Endor for Sullust, Admiral Chiraneau for Bespin) that are not made in the list; the list is kept as posted.
A later, different version by the same author is deck 19688 (Big Blue DONE RIGHT - No Money No Parts NO R3).
